owner: activation value; no alias
root: no managed root; immediate scalar
pin: not-needed; no address-sensitive use
carrier: SSA/register or stack value
escalation: compile error only if representation unexpectedly needs an address

owner: caller/activation owns object; aliases retain identity
root: GC-visible local/stack root while live
pin: not-needed for tagged access; reload after calls
carrier: managed heap object plus stack map
escalation: generic Tier 1 required if uniqueness cannot be proved

owner: caller owns value; callback borrows read-only
root: caller root and callback argument root
pin: stable only for callback; otherwise managed reference
carrier: callback-scoped borrow; stable slot or rooted heap
escalation: borrow escape or callback retention is a compile error

owner: caller remains owner; mutable borrow is exclusive
root: owner root remains live through callback
pin: owner pin covers entire exclusive callback
carrier: stable slot or pinned heap; close borrow before re-entry
escalation: unknown alias/re-entry requires reload or compile error

owner: one source owner transfers to destination
root: destination root after commit; source root ends
pin: pin transfers only if destination address use requires it
carrier: move into return slot, frame, region, or transfer token
escalation: post-move source use or failed transfer ownership is a compile error

owner: source owner remains; clone gets independent owner
root: both roots until their last uses
pin: new owner pins independently; no inherited address assumption
carrier: new managed allocation or defined copy carrier
escalation: copy failure or non-copyable defined behavior must use its error path

owner: parent owns record; projection is a borrow
root: parent root covers projection
pin: parent pin or reload; projection cannot outlive parent pin
carrier: parent handle plus offset reload or stable slot
escalation: parent move/shape change without reload is a compile error

owner: parent owns record; each projection is exclusive
root: parent root plus both projection roots/borrow tokens
pin: parent pin covers both; offsets proven disjoint
carrier: field pins or parent stable heap
escalation: overlap, dynamic property, or unknown layout is a compile error for raw projections

owner: region owns allocations and borrows
root: region token/root remains until destruction
pin: region allocation stable for in-region address uses
carrier: scoped region/arena with reverse-order cleanup
escalation: region escape or missing exceptional cleanup is a compile error

owner: caller owns buffer; foreign call borrows only
root: caller root through foreign return
pin: foreign-call pin covers exactly the call
carrier: stable stack slot or explicitly pinned external buffer
escalation: foreign retention or allocator mismatch is a compile error

owner: continuation owns live local
root: continuation frame fields are strong roots
pin: frame field pin only if frame is stable; otherwise reload
carrier: stable continuation frame or heap promotion
escalation: missing frame root or stable carrier is a compile error

owner: caller initially owns input; continuation needs a new owner or copy
root: caller root cannot be assumed while suspended
pin: no stack pin across await; promoted owner must pin if view survives
carrier: copy, promoted owner, or continuation-owned handle
escalation: borrow-across-suspend without carrier is a compile error

owner: continuation/registration owns pending state
root: promise/continuation and cancellation registration roots
pin: pin lasts through cleanup only
carrier: continuation frame plus registration token
escalation: unsettled promise or late callback after release is a compile error

owner: generator owns continuation and source state
root: generator object roots frame; consumer roots retained yield
pin: copy yielded view or explicit owner pin outlives consumer use
carrier: generator frame plus copy or transfer carrier
escalation: yielded borrow outlives frame or close cleanup is a compile error

owner: Effect scope owns resource, finalizer, and child state
root: fiber/scope continuation roots resource and cause
pin: finalizer pin lasts through cleanup
carrier: scoped region plus continuation frame
escalation: missing finalizer ordering or scope exit is a compile error

owner: child fiber owns moved value after fork
root: fiber scheduler and join scope root child state
pin: child carrier pins only while address use is active
carrier: fiber-owned continuation/heap state; no parent alias
escalation: parent use after move or fork failure with two owners is a compile error

owner: join scope owns shared immutable value
root: all fibers and join scope are roots
pin: not-needed for immutable managed reads; pin only for address use
carrier: join-owned region or rooted immutable heap
escalation: mutation through a read proof is a compile error or generic path

owner: synchronized cell/scope owns shared mutable state
root: all participating fibers and finalizer root state
pin: cell pin/lock covers each operation, not whole suspension
carrier: atomic or synchronized cell; refcount only if independent
escalation: unsynchronized alias or unbalanced interruption cleanup is a compile error

owner: foreign library owns returned buffer; caller has temporary borrow
root: foreign lifetime handle/contract roots owner while valid
pin: foreign pin or immediate copy covers use
carrier: foreign pin/handle or immediate owned copy
escalation: foreign validity interval or allocator is unknown: compile error

owner: registration/external allocation owns retained data
root: registration token and callback handle root data
pin: external allocation or foreign pin lasts to unregister and late callback
carrier: promoted external object plus registration token
escalation: retention, late callback, or release protocol missing: compile error

owner: native call frame and registration own active state
root: VM handles root callback, captures, and active state
pin: stable native frame or explicit external pin across callback
carrier: stable native frame plus GC handles
escalation: raw JSC pointer or mutable borrow across re-entry is a compile error

owner: cancellation token owns registration until delivery is impossible
root: registration and callback handles remain rooted through race
pin: pin/owner lasts until unregister acknowledgement or late delivery
carrier: registration token with synchronized close
escalation: release before late callback or double completion is a compile error

owner: activation/continuation owns live JS value
root: stack map or strong GC handle at every safepoint
pin: no pin for tagged use; reload after possible movement
carrier: managed value plus stack map/handle
escalation: unregistered live value is a compile error

owner: rooted owner remains responsible for object
root: strong GC handle or frame root
pin: explicit GC pin covers raw address use
carrier: pinned GC handle or reloadable rooted handle
escalation: root without stable address, or raw unregistered pointer, is a compile error

owner: parent owner remains responsible for projected field
root: parent GC handle roots complete object
pin: parent pin covers interior address; reload if unpinned
carrier: parent handle plus reload or explicit projection pin
escalation: stale projection or unknown parent movement is a compile error

owner: registration owns callback and captured environment
root: GC registration/strong handle roots callback until deregistered
pin: pin only during synchronous callback; registration is not address pin
carrier: GC handle plus deregistration token
escalation: callback retention or deregistration exit is unclassified: compile error

owner: promoted heap object owns captured state
root: queue, closure, frame, or registration roots promotion
pin: stable heap/external pin only for address-sensitive consumers
carrier: heap promotion plus GC handle
escalation: escape without promotion or release owner is a compile error

owner: GC owns target conditionally; WeakRef does not own it
root: no strong root until deref result is acquired
pin: no pin from weak reachability; pin the strong result if needed
carrier: weak handle plus explicit strong result/root
escalation: using weak liveness as a borrow/root/pin is a compile error

owner: receiver owns new clone; sender retains source
root: queue roots clone while delivery is pending
pin: clone has independent address; no source pin transfer
carrier: structured-clone allocation plus queue root
escalation: clone failure or queue ownership is not represented: compile error

owner: receiver becomes sole backing-store owner at commit
root: transfer token/queue roots pending receiver
pin: backing store address belongs to receiver after commit
carrier: transfer token and detached sender state
escalation: source use after commit or enqueue failure consuming source is a compile error

owner: shared backing-store owner protocol spans workers
root: all worker handles and GC references root shared object
pin: stable shared storage; each access still obeys atomic/synchronization rules
carrier: shared GC handle plus atomic storage
escalation: non-atomic mutable alias or missing worker release is a compile error

owner: queue/port owns callback and captured environment
root: queue, port, and worker registration roots captures
pin: no raw stack pin; promote and pin external state when required
carrier: heap-promoted closure plus thread/GC handle
escalation: stack borrow or JS-heap pointer crosses thread without carrier: compile error

owner: main and worker each own an independent native reference
root: thread-safe owner/refcount roots resource until final release
pin: stable external allocation or synchronized operation pin
carrier: reference count only with atomic protocol and named owners
escalation: an enclosing join/region exists, or synchronization/release is missing: compile error
